payments.rejectText: The organizer is notified and can submit a new request.

diagnostics.title: Error chain probe
diagnostics.text: Triggers a deliberate exception (500). The returned requestId must show up in the error tracker: that proves errors are reported end to end.
diagnostics.triggered: Test exception triggered: find this requestId in the error tracker.

pickers.typeToSearchEvents: Type to search, or leave blank to see recent events.

agreements.intro: Every enterprise or on-premise billing period on record.
agreements.emptyText: Create an agreement to open a billing period for a tenant.
agreements.renewText: Closes the current period and opens the next one, ending at the date below.
agreements.interruptText: For an ENTERPRISE_SAAS deal this also suspends the tenant immediately.
agreements.createText: Open a billing period for an enterprise or on-premise deal. The amount is optional; the platform currency is {currency}.

trials.endText: The event's allowance reverts to its paid entitlement and the organizer is notified.
trials.intro: Every trial ever granted, newest first.
trials.emptyText: Grant a trial to unlock a free allowance for one event.
trials.showingAll: Showing {count, plural, one {# trial} other {all # trials}}.
trials.grantText: Grant a free allowance for one event. The organizer is notified instantly and sees a countdown to the deadline in their own dashboard.
trials.tierHint: This capacity and price are granted for free: pick deliberately.
trials.grantedToast: Trial granted: the organizer has been notified.
trials.pickBoth: Pick an organization and an event first.

billing.defaultsText: Nothing has been saved yet, so the values below come from the platform configuration. Saving here takes over and becomes the source of truth.
billing.payeeText: Where organizers send their Mobile Money or bank transfers. Shown verbatim in every payment instruction.
billing.bankPlaceholder: Bank, branch, account number, account name…
billing.bankHint: Free text shown to the organizer. Leave empty to hide the bank option.
billing.tiersText: The capacity tiers an organizer can request for an event, ascending by guests. Each price is set by hand in GNF, FCFA (XOF and XAF) and US cents (ADR 105).
billing.plansText: Priced for the team: the monthly price covers the included people, then each extra person costs the extra price. Leave the cap empty for no limit, and the extra price at zero for a plan that takes no one more. Yearly payment charges ten months.
